entries.msgstr: You cannot choose a Combat Reserve during active fighting.

Repeatedly choosing the %(reserve_name)s Reserve
will improve its characteristics.

Repeatedly choosing the %(first_reserve_name)s or %(second_reserve_name)s Reserve
will improve the characteristics of the one selected.
Deploys an active minefield in the selected area for a certain period of time.
Causes considerable damage to enemy vehicles within a small radius.
Stuns enemy vehicles and causes medium damage within a large radius.
Adds a bonus to the major qualification of the player's crew and allied crews.
Provides a bonus to capture speed, capture blocking, and resupply.
Restores a certain percentage of your vehicle's hit points.
Conceals all vehicles inside and behind the smoke.
Provides a bonus to concealment and view range. Reduces the concealment of enemy vehicles.
